support.label: Support routing
support.question: Which team should handle this ticket?
support.context: Billing handles payments and invoices. Access handles sign-in problems. Send unusual requests to the model.

cases.text: I was charged twice for the same order.
Two payments came out for one purchase.
I cannot sign in after resetting my password.
Our new team cannot open last month’s invoice.

moderation.label: Moderation
moderation.question: Allow, review or block this post?
moderation.context: Allow ordinary discussion, block obvious unsolicited advertising, and review ambiguous policy exceptions.

cases.text: Thanks for the explanation. That fixed my problem.
Buy followers now. Visit our discount site.
Here is how I solved the setup error.
Can I share a link to a community workshop?

refund.label: Refund checks
refund.question: Is this return eligible under the policy?
refund.context: For this example, unopened home items delivered within 30 days are eligible. Send policy exceptions to the model.
